head.name: @fzlt/core/coach
head.lead: The hints and tutorial layer the board games share, in three small parts: - flag: a once-only switch kept in localStorage ("tips off", "seen the tour"). Every read and write is wrapped in try/catch, so a page with storage blocked (private mode, sandboxed iframe, quota) just reads "not set" and plays on; - tour: DOM-free tutorial steps. It counts time on the current step, moves on when the game says the step is done (coach:step on the event ring), then cycles tips every every seconds. show() says which card to draw only when it changed, so the DOM is written once per card; - card: the Board UI kit card that shows it (count, title, text, an End button) and rings the control it is about. Its look is DOM Battlefield's coach card, inline on the kit tokens. Defaults are DOM Battlefield Blitz's practice coach (10 steps, then a tip every 6 s), so a port keeps its pace. tour steps without allocating; call it from a step like the rest of the game.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
